newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill ups Intel EPS view.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill ups Intel EPS view.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch analyst Tom Kurlak reiterated his near- and long-term buy ratings, raised his 1997 earnings projection and introduced a new estimate for 1998.
-- In published comments, the analyst said he raised his 1997 earnings estimate to $9.30 per share from $9.00 and introduced a 1998 estimate of $11.
-- Kurlak said he maintained his 12-month price objective of $200 for the stock, or 18 times estimated 1998 earnings.
